text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zimbabwe press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Zimbabwean paper and packaging company Hunyani Holdings Limited has made an offer to acquire the entire issued capital of another packaging firm FP Holdings Limited, a development market analysts say will strengthen Hunyani's product range.

- The British government has made representations to the Zimbabwean government over the latter's controversial decision to sell part of Hwange thermal power station to Malaysian company YTL Corp BHD , visiting British trade minister Anthony Nelson said on Wednesday.

- Anglo American Corporation of South Africa Ltd will not be making any changes to its management structure in Zimbabwe despite the recent sale of Lonrho Plc sahres to Anglo by former CEO Dieter Bock, an Anglo spokesman told the Zimbabwe Independent on Thursday.

- The Zimbabwean government has issued letters of dismissal to 700 Zimbabwean nurses -- currently taking part in a nation-wide strike by junior doctors and nurses for better pay and working conditions which entered into its 15th day on Thursday.
- The Zimbabwean government says it will have to stagger the payment of annual bonuses to its civil servants over a three month period between November and February owing to cash-flow problems.
